extras: Works locally in the vault and does not make network requests or collect telemetry.
intentEvidence: Unresolved Link Helper improves the workflow for creating notes from unresolved internal links in Obsidian.
problem: Manually creating a note and setting up aliases when following an unresolved internal link is cumbersome.
summary: Intercept unresolved internal links in Obsidian, allowing users to create new notes, define titles and folders, and add the link text as an alias.
